newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil recovers, diesel premiums firm again.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil recovers, diesel premiums firm again.

text.p: NWE gas oil rose on Friday in line with a recovery in November IPE futures and higher premiums for diesel rose on perceptions of extremely tight supply, traders said.
"There have been some very high levels talked for diesel," one trader said.
IPE Nov futures closed up $2 at $227.00, recovering from a $13.75 slump on Thursday, in what brokers described as a technical consolidation.
One trader reported a bid of Nov IPE +$37 cif Lorient for a prompt diesel cargo, $7 above last done.
"Diesel in France, Germany and the U.K. is incredibly tight and there are no stocks at all," a British trading manager said.
But heating oil was steady as more cargoes were fixed to sail from the U.S. Gulf to Europe.
Cargo premiums were seen at Nov IPE +$6/8, but business was described as thin, with buyers holding off in the hope of lower prices as availability grows.
On the barge market, diesel traded about $3 higher at Nov IPE +$35.50 fob ARA, for -7/-22 grade. Heating oil barges were steady at Nov IPE +$6-8 fob ARA.
